{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend coat, straight cut, knee length, #2F4F4F, heavy woven wool.
Crisp white button-down blouse, relaxed fit, long sleeves, #FFFFFF, cotton-poplin.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in dark denim, full length, #1C1C1C, rigid twill.
Minimalist gold pendant necklace, #D4AF37, solid brass.
Delicate stack of thin gold rings, mixed tones, #F0E68C, polished metal.
Low-block heel ankle boots, closed toe, #2F2F2F, smooth leather.

This outfit perfectly balances your desire for a restrained and classic look with the practical needs of a snowy Saturday evening in the city center. The dark wool coat and deep denim trousers provide essential warmth against the minus-three degree frost while maintaining a sleek, elongated silhouette that flatters your figure. By keeping accessories minimal and refined, the ensemble honors your request for timelessness without sacrificing comfort for a long walk with friends."}
